comment: No source is published and the panel SVG is a 1x1 placeholder. Param 8 and output 11 are never configured and have no widget, so neither can be clicked and neither gets a line. The chance of a bit changing never quite reaches one in two: the keep probability runs from 100 percent down to about 52.5 percent and then jumps to always-flip below 0.05, which differs from the hardware's even coin toss at the centre.
